Development of this SDK happens in Paysera's internal GitLab. This GitHub repository is a

change to GitLab, and it reaches this repository with the next release.
See CONTRIBUTING.md for details.

## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change: one logical change per pull request.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated so the change is covered.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under a `## Unreleased` heading.
- [ ] The local quality gates from the "Running quality gates locally" section of `CONTRIBUTING.md` pass.
